meta.name: news-summary
meta.description: This skill should be used when the user asks for news updates, daily briefings, or what's happening in the world. Fetches news from trusted international RSS feeds and can create voice summaries.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 获取最新新闻并生成语音摘要
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果想快速了解每日新闻要点
copy.tagline_en: Fetch latest news and generate voice summaries
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want quick daily news highlights

howto.what: 当你要了解新闻时，Claude 会从 BBC、路透社等国际 RSS 源获取最新头条，整理成按地区或主题分组的文字摘要，也可以生成语音播报。
howto.when: 当你询问新闻动态、每日简报或世界上正在发生什么时触发。

say.note: Claude 会抓取 BBC 世界新闻并生成摘要。

say.text: 给我一份今天的科技新闻简报。
say.note: Claude 会从 BBC 科技频道获取新闻。

say.text: 用语音播报今天的头条新闻。
say.note: Claude 会生成文字摘要并转为语音发送。

howto.what_en: When you ask for news, Claude fetches top headlines from international RSS feeds (BBC, Reuters, etc.), groups them by region or topic, and produces a concise text summary. It can also generate a voice summary using OpenAI TTS.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask for news updates, daily briefings, or what's happening in the world.

say_en.note: Claude fetches BBC world news and summarizes.

say_en.text: Give me a tech news briefing for today.
say_en.note: Claude fetches from BBC technology feed.

say_en.text: Read me the top headlines in audio.
say_en.note: Claude creates a text summary and converts to speech.
